newsitem.title: UK: Chloride gets 18 mln stg pension refund.
newsitem.headline: Chloride gets 18 mln stg pension refund.

text.p: British industrial group Chloride Group Plc said on Thursday it had received a refund of 18 million stg representing residual assets left after winding up its Chloride UK pension scheme.

The refund follows a process launched in June last year to enhance and transfer several thousand pensions from its old corporate scheme into a new one. It will allow Chloride to clear a prepayment of 14.8 million stg already on its balance sheet and post an exceptional gain this year of 3.2 million stg.
"The enhanced cash position of the group will provide greater financial resources for the future development of the business," Chloride added.
As part of the transformation, Chloride has already settled a tax bill of 12.0 million stg and the old scheme is close to completion of its wind up, the company said .
